539-997-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-997-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat

1981-2034-2415-6794.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

225-1308-3129-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-5662-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2946-4871-6797-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-6797-7316.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1879-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-1879-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1879-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

643-4529-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu.
When God-Eternal Bontu dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Bontu's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Bontu.
As God-Eternal Bontu is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Bontu from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

907-1558-3875-4231-4365.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-4365.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-1437-1993-3861--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-1437-1993-3861--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4155-6871.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, earthbending The Stasis Coffin, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate The Stasis Coffin by paying {2}, tapping and exiling it.
The Stasis Coffin triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Stasis Coffin ability from step 2, causing you to gain protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

360-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-5231-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-3742-4251-4452-6968.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-2457-4289-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1913-2073-5315--90.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

3603-6333--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the extra turn spell and Cloudshift each turn.
There are at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
3603-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Cloudshift from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
3603-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

679-2353-6191.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

608-2022-2034-2557-5495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
It is your turn.
608-2022-2034-2557-5495.description:
Activate Thallid Soothsayer by paying {2} and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card.
An opponent's Wedding Ring's second ability triggers, causing them to draw a card.
Xyris' first ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Snake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

774-2137-2701.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
774-2137-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Dark Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

864-2034-2103-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kenrith's last ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1479-3257-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-4488.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

862-2816-4763-5147.description:
Equip Crimson Kolbolds with Umbral Mantle.
Sacrifice Crimson Kobolds to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to you hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds.
Repeat.

2702-3348.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, Island Sanctuary causes you to skip your card draw, and prevent creatures without flying and/or islandwalk from attacking you.
Because Archetype of Imagination causes all creatures to lose flying, only creatures with islandwalk can attack you.

614-1987-2510-4714.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1987-2510-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
